name: coding-agent-orchestration-harness
description: An orchestration harness for managing and coordinating multiple coding agents in a workflow.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, delegate, implement, and review coding tasks with a reusable agent harness.
interface.longDescription: Provides a coding-agent orchestration harness with shared orchestration instructions and researcher, worker, and reviewer roles.
defaultPrompt: Use the coding-agent orchestration harness for this task. Apply the orchestration harness skill, then delegate research, implementation, and review work where useful.
